What We Do

Everything your roof needs, done properly

From a single leaking tile to a full restoration, every job follows the same careful process, done properly from start to finish.

Roof Restoration

Our complete clean, repair, seal and coat system brings an ageing tile or metal roof back to near-new condition — and adds years of life without the cost of replacement.

Roof Repairs

Broken tiles, cracked bedding, rusted valleys and worn flashing — we find the real cause of the problem and repair it so it stays fixed, not patched over.

Roof Cleaning & Coating

High-pressure cleaning strips away moss, lichen and years of grime, followed by a premium membrane coating that seals and protects your roof from the weather.

Roof Painting

A fresh colour changes the whole look of your home. We prepare the surface properly, then apply durable roof paint in the colour of your choice.

Gutter Replacement

Rusted, sagging or overflowing gutters cause real damage. We replace gutters and downpipes with quality Colorbond® steel, matched to your roof.

Leak Detection

A stain on the ceiling rarely sits under the actual leak. We trace water entry points methodically and fix the source — so the leak doesn't come back next storm.

How It Works

Our 5-step restoration process

No shortcuts. Every restored roof goes through the same five steps, in order, so the finish lasts.

01

Inspection

We inspect your roof in person, photograph any issues, and give you a written, obligation-free quote.

02

Clean

A full high-pressure clean removes moss, lichen, dirt and loose material from every tile and ridge.

03

Repair

Broken tiles are replaced, ridge caps re-bedded and re-pointed, and valleys and flashing repaired.

04

Coat

A sealer and two coats of premium roof membrane are applied in your chosen colour for lasting protection.

05

Final Check

We walk the finished roof with you and tidy the site completely before we leave.

Good Questions

What Newcastle homeowners ask us

How much does a roof restoration cost?+

It depends on your roof's size, pitch, tile type and how much repair work it needs before coating. What we can say: a restoration typically costs a fraction of a full roof replacement, and your inspection and written quote are free — so you'll know the exact figure before you commit to anything.

How long does a restoration take?+

Most homes are finished in 2–4 days, depending on roof size and weather. Cleaning and repairs usually happen on day one, with sealing and coating over the following days. We'll give you a clear schedule with your quote.

Do you work on both tile and metal roofs?+

Yes. We restore, repair, clean and coat both tile and metal roofs. The exact steps vary a little by roof type — for example, a metal roof may need rust treatment and fastener checks — and we'll explain what's involved for your roof when we quote.

Do I need to be home during the work?+

No. As long as we can access the roof and an outdoor tap and power point, we can complete the work while you're out. We'll keep you updated and walk you through the finished roof when you return.

Can you fix a leak without a full restoration?+

Absolutely. Plenty of leaks come down to one cracked tile, failed pointing or a rusted valley. We'll trace the leak to its source, show you what we find, and quote just the repair — no upsell to a full restoration if your roof doesn't need one.
